gloss: to start (a business); to revive; to establish

definitions.gloss: to start; to establish; to found
definitions.explanation: To launch or found something new, especially a business, organization, or movement.
To bring something back to a prosperous or active state after a period of decline.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{若|わか}くして{事業|じぎょう}を{興|おこ}した。
examples.english: My father started a business when he was young.

examples.japanese: ゼロから{会社|かいしゃ}を{興|おこ}すのは{簡単|かんたん}ではない。
examples.english: Starting a company from scratch is not easy.

examples.japanese: {仲間|なかま}と{一緒|いっしょ}にNPOを{興|おこ}して、{地域|ちいき}の{問題|もんだい}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: I founded an NPO with friends and am working on local issues.

examples.japanese: {衰退|すいたい}した{産業|さんぎょう}を{興|おこ}す。
{観光|かんこう}で{町|まち}を{興|おこ}そうという{計画|けいかく}が{持|も}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: A plan was proposed to revitalize the town through tourism.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}の{荒廃|こうはい}から{国|くに}を{興|おこ}すために、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{力|ちから}を{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: Many people joined forces to rebuild the nation from the devastation of the postwar period.

notes:
{興|おこ}す is a transitive godan verb. It is distinct from {起|お}こす (to wake someone up, to cause), which is written with a different kanji.

ASPECT (ている):
{興|おこ}している indicates an ongoing process of establishing or reviving something.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- {事業|じぎょう}を{興|おこ}す (start a business)
- {国|くに}を{興|おこ}す (found/revive a nation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事業|じぎょう}を{興|おこ}す (start a business)
- {産業|さんぎょう}を{興|おこ}す (establish/revive an industry)
- {国|くに}を{興|おこ}す (build/revive a nation)

Often appears in compound forms like {再興|さいこう} (revival) and {振興|しんこう} (promotion). The kanji {興|おこ} carries the sense of prosperity and flourishing.
